tokens: "You unlock the door with the key. Congratulations, you have escaped!\n"
"You light the candle. The room is now illuminated.\n"
"You use a match. It lights up for a few seconds and then extinguishes.\n"
"You read the book. It contains some interesting stories and puzzles. You feel smarter.\n"
"You use the %s to defeat the dragon and reach the treasure! Congratulations, you have won!\n"
"There is no dragon here to fight with.\n"
"You drink the potion. You feel stronger and healthier.\n"
"You are in a dark, damp cell. There is a door to the south, locked with a rusty key."
"You are in a long, narrow hallway. There are passages to the north, east, and west."
"You are in a small kitchen. There is a passage to the west and a table with a candle on it."
"You are in a large library. There are passages to the south and east and a book on the desk."
"You are in an armory. There is a passage to the north and a sword and a shield on the wall."
"You are in a creepy dungeon. There is a passage to the east and a chest near the wall."
"You are in a strange laboratory. There is a passage to the north and a potion on the table."
"You are trapped in a dungeon and you need to find the way out.\n"
"You can move to the north, east, south, and west using the commands 'go north', 'go east', etc.\n"
"You can take items using the command 'take <item>' and drop them using the command 'drop <item>'.\n"
"You can use items in your inventory using the command 'use <item>'.\n"
